usedFor: ActiveCampaign is the source of events like “New Campaign Link Click”, and Razorpay receives them as a “Create Payment Link”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Deal Added or Updated” in ActiveCampaign, then “Create Payment Link” in Razorpay
bestTemplate.why: The action takes amount, expiry and customer details, so a deal can come with a shareable link ready to pay.

watchOut: “New Deal Added or Updated” fires on updates too, so one deal can create a second Razorpay payment link.
